The compiler puts a non-hash in regs[a] for a hash/array literal whose first entry is a double-splat of a non-hash with a further pair: {**0, m:0} compiles to LOADI_0 R2 ; HASHADD R2 1 (R2 = Integer 0). Invariant: at OP_HASHADD, regs[a] must be a hash.

root_cause: njs_function_frame_save (src/njs_function.c) saves the async frame at await by copying *vm->active_frame, carrying the source frame's spare-memory allocator fields native->{size,free,free_size}; the source frame is then freed by the njs_vmcode_return at the tail of njs_vmcode_await. On resume njs_await_fulfilled (src/njs_async.c) sets vm->top_frame to the saved frame, so a call made by the resumed body runs njs_function_frame_alloc, whose fast path (size <= vm->top_frame->free_size) reuses vm->top_frame->free; that pointer indexes the freed source chunk, so the njs_memzero of the new frame header (src/njs_function.c:574) writes into freed memory (the reported heap-use-after-free WRITE). The crash is depth-gated: it requires the source frame to have used the slow-path large allocation (njs_mp_alloc_large, freed with free()), which happens only for deep enough recursion (base: OK at depth 10, report from depth 30).
